programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The historic home of JP Speed has morphed into an Arts College, carrying on the legacy of the local entrepreneur’s second wife, Harriet, who was passionate about sharing her love for music and the humanities and is said to still be haunting the home.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Rowdy Roddy Piper, Skylar Grey, Frank Whaley
programme.desc: After Rowdy's best friend Adrian Adonis dies tragically, Rowdy learns that Adrian has his back even from the beyond. Skylar Grey, at a low point in her career, is viciously attacked by an evil spirit in her hotel room.
programme.sub-title: Rowdy Roddy Piper, Skylar Grey, Frank Whaley

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval
programme.desc: Aaron Carter's dying grandmother makes him promise her that he will perform a ritual after she dies to prove that spirits really do exist.
programme.sub-title: Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tito Ortiz, Cary Elwes. Sally Kellerman, Drake Bell
programme.desc: One of the toughest men in the world, Tito Ortiz, encounters a spirits that terrifies him and his girlfriend. Cary Elwes has a brush with a bone chilling skeletal ghost.
programme.sub-title: Tito Ortiz, Cary Elwes. Sally Kellerman, Drake Bell

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tiffany, Tony Plana, Morgan Brittany
programme.desc: An angry teenage Tiffany reads the Satanic bible and unleashes evil from the other side. Tony Plana encounters a cannibalistic entity that leaves him fearing for his life.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the Perryville Battlefield, the site of one of the Civil War’s bloodiest fights, the HP Bottom House has purportedly witnessed countless apparitions and other chilling phenomena.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Augusta is home to Kentucky’s oldest jail, which housed prisoners since the early 1800s and still sits upon its original foundation today. While it now operates as a museum, there have been numerous guests who have claimed to see unexplainable things.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime fixture of the paranormal investigative landscape, Mackey’s has developed a reputation for being one of America’s creepiest haunts, supposedly hosting a dark energy that can leave some investigators mentally scarred.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Forfatteren Ellison (Ethan Hawke) skriver kriminalsaker fra virkeligheten og er på jakt etter en ny bestselger. Uten å fortelle resten av familien om sine motiver, flytter de til et hus der det tidligere har skjedd en rekke bestialske drap.

programme.title: Isabelle
programme.desc: Isabelle tar opp arven fra 'Rosemary's Baby' og 'Eksorsisten'. Et vanlig amerikansk ektepar flytter inn i et perfekt villastrøk i New England. Men drømmen om å starte et lykkelig familieliv blir snart knust.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Meiji Kinenkan is the oldest bridal hall in Japan undergoing an upgrade to celebrate its 50th anniversary. This includes the addition of a Chinese restaurant and its new grand chef.

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Morimoto battles with Challenger Tsuyoshi Kajimoto as they innovate with abalone, a shellfish.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The Iron Chef is called upon to face Miyoko Sakai, a famed Thai food critic who has had the privilege to learn the secrets of royal Thai cuisine straight from the source.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Morimoto faces another traditionalist who is infamous for his temper, his steadfast discipline and his adherence to tradition.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The challenger in this battle of peach is Masanobu Watabe, owner of Le Rameau d'Or in Yokohama, Japan. Watabe runs the entire 22-seat restaurant by himself.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Chen's challenger is a man who masters Chaozhou-style Chinese cuisine, an exacting style that is actually able to please the sensitive tastes of customers in Kyoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Sakai battles the 'conjurer of garlic,' a chef who embraces the pungent ingredient as real Italians do. Sakai is further challenged to use live squids in the dishes.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Three years after losing to Iron Chef Chen, the Italian restaurant Sabatini demands a rematch, this time sending in the master chef of their Tokyo restaurant.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Led by Tadamichi Ohta, the chef who defeated Sakai, the Ohta faction invades Kitchen Stadium to uphold traditional Japanese cuisine. Fuji is team Ohta's first contender against Morimoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Tasaki is a world champion sommelier who has always dreamed of becoming a famed chef. Chairman Kaga decides to grant him his wish.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The American chef Ron Seigel challenges Iron Chef Sakai in this battle of lobster. Who will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The first female challenger at Kitchen Stadium, the 26-year-old Kagata defeated Chef Chen. Years later, she returns to fight Chen again with milk-fed veal.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Natto, a Japanese delicacy, is the ingredient of battle for Iron Chef Morimoto and Tatsutoshi Kumamoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Kobe is pitted against an unusual chef of Italian cuisine who operates out of his own food cart.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Nagayama was brought in to revive the venerated Tokyo University restaurant Shochiku and now he will fight against an Iron Chef.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: When it comes to Bok Choy, you know that Iron Chef Chen will be there to defend his honor against Hisao Yaginuma.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The challenger likes to follow one of the philosophies of Rosanjin: 'never kill the natural flavor of the ingredient.' He is known as the prince of Japanese cuisine.

programme.desc: Blake blir mistenkt for et angivelig drap på Elsworth Chisolm. Zorelli får ansvar for Grimes-saken igjen. Charles Matthews advarer Blake om at Zorelli har spurt ham ut om Blakes far.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Jeff og Dex møter kona til Roger Grimes og får vite at han har en sønn. Sable er gravid og får seg ikke til å fortelle Dex at han er faren.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Charles Matthews forteller Blake en dyster hemmelighet. Zorelli finner avlyttingsutstyr i leiligheten sin. Alexis forteller Monica at Jason Colby ikke er faren hennes.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis truer med å saksøke Blake for halvparten av den stjålne nazi-skatten hvis ikke Sable trekker tilbake søksmålet mot Colbyco. Sable går med på det. Krystina fører Fallon til skatten.

programme.title: Dynasty: Oil
programme.desc: Krystle Grant Jennings forbereder seg på å gifte seg med den rike oljemagnaten Blake Carrington, da Matthew Blaisdel, en tidligere elsker, vender tilbake til byen og gir henne kalde føtter.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: 4400s across the world are coming down with strange and life threatening illnesses. Tom and Diana learn a horrible secret that the government may have directly caused the illnesses of the 4400s.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Discovering that NTAC is behind the disease plaguing the 4400s, Tom and Diana try to get to the bottom of NTAC's cover-up, while Kyle considers turning himself in.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Ranger Freddie Gonzalez must team up with an old enemy to bring down a demon hell-bent on enslaving culebras. Meanwhile, Seth and Richie track down an ancient hunter.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: When Amaru puts Scott Fuller in her sights, the Geckos and their team must defend him against Brasa's most lethal fighters yet - Jaguar Warriors from hell.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: A cannibal attack in a suburban neighborhood forces Seth to bring his makeshift team together to save innocent civilians.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: After being kidnapped by Amaru, Richie wakes up in an abandoned asylum and calls Seth for help. Sensing a trap, Seth brings the team - and Amaru unleashes a demon like no other.

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.

programme.desc: We explore the abandoned Chesterfield Mall in Missouri, opened in the 1970s, closed in 2022 , empty corridors, decaying storefronts, now demolished.

programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Pet Sematary

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en av de sedan länge försvunna grundarna av Samväldet, men upptäcker att hon kan vara mer besvärlig än vad hon är värd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Odjurets mage
programme.desc: Ett mytologiskt rymdmonster försöker äta Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Riddaren, döden och djävulen
programme.desc: Dylan försöker befria en flotta av tillfångatagna skepp, men flottan är inte säker på att den vill bli befriad. Deras AI:er fruktar att nya kaptener kommer att förslava dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Obefläckad varseblivning
programme.desc: Geniter attackerar Tyrs fru och koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunneln i slutet av ljuset
programme.desc: Med femtio partier ombord är Dylan värd för undertecknandet av stadgan för det nya samväldet, men upptäcker snart att det finns inkräktare som är fast beslutna att stoppa undertecknandet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Om hjulet är fast
programme.desc: Beka och Tyr tas över av energin från en dimensionell tunnel. Dylan, Trance och Harper måste rädda dem innan de förstör skeppet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skärvor
programme.desc: Dylan blir anklagad för mord och måste rentvå sitt namn samtidigt som han hittar delarna till en vas som sägs ge ägaren "kosmos välsignelser".

programme.title: Andromeda: Galet att bli räddad
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en grupp flyktingar, men upptäcker att de har utsatts för regeringsexperiment och är extremt instabila.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekkas farbror kandiderar till ett ämbete i det nya samväldet, men ett mordförsök får besättningen att agera som hans säkerhetsvakt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensamma och jämna sanden
programme.desc: När Andromeda attackeras av rymdpirater räddas de av ett sedan länge försvunnet rymdskepp från jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter det krigshundarna
programme.desc: Besättningen upptäcker att en oseriös planet, Marduk, har skapat massförstörelsevapen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den Lepers kyss
programme.desc: En torped vid namn Leper har ledarna för det nya samväldets ledare som måltavla.

programme.title: Andromeda: För vem klockan ringer
programme.desc: Andromeda hemsöks av en mystisk varelse som kommer ombord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: Och ditt hjärta kommer att flyga iväg
programme.desc: När en förlorad kärlek återvänder försvinner Tyr från skeppet för att skydda henne från en lönnmördare.
programme.sub-title: Och ditt hjärta kommer att flyga iväg

programme.title: Andromeda: Den oövervinneliga mannen
programme.desc: Den utspelar sig i ett alternativt universum där Dylan dog och Gaheris Rhade försöker reformera Samväldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som attackerade Andromeda under det första undertecknandet av Samväldets stadgar återvänder för att ställa till med mer förödelse.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mörka bakåt
programme.desc: Trance går igenom ett antal olika scenarier och försöker hitta ett där hennes besättningskamrater inte dör.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det Risk-allt-punkten
programme.desc: Ett kraftfullare Andromedaskepp exploderar på grund av sabotage, vilket tvingar Dylans besättning att rädda dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rätta hästen
programme.desc: Beka äventyrar både hennes besättning och en hel planet när en tidigare kärlek dyker upp.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog

programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out

programme.desc: Audrina försöker kommer över Justin genom att lägga ögonen på Brody. Heidi tvingar med sig Spencer på parterapi och när Stephanie strular till det på People´s Revolution hotar Lauren med att säga upp henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina försöker komma över Justin genom att haka upp med Brody när flickorna krascha pojkarnas surfa resa till Hawaii. Heidis jungfru ex-pojkvän kommer på besök och hon hoppas några av hans värderingar kommer att smitta av sig på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrinas hjärta krossas när Brodys flickvän konfronterar henne med frågor om Hawaii och Brody gör ingenting för att stoppa henne. Heidi läser ett sms från Stacie till Spencer och drar till en nattklubb för att konfrontera henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterar Audrina om att hon strulade med Brody på Hawaii. Stephanie förstör en fotografering på jobbet och Lauren ställs till svars inför Kelly. Bartendern Stacie försöker att bli sams med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer försöker att rädda förhållandet med Heidi genom att be hennes far om hennes hand. Lauren tvingas att avskeda Stephanie från People's Revolution - vilket riskerar att förstöra deras vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin startar krig när hon flörtar med Justin framför näsan på Audrina. Trots att de letar ny bostad tillsammans köper Spencer en utan att Heidi godkänt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Efter att Audrina struntat i henne, beslutar sig Kristin för att inte kämpa emot att hon är så attraherad av Justin. Heidi erbjuder sig att sitta barnvakt åt grannen, men Spencer vill inte ha nåt med barn att göra.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får känna på hur det är att vara i ett förhållande med Justin när han aldrig dyker upp på Brodys överraskningsfest. Heidi och Spencer är inte överens om när de ska skaffa barn, och Audrina går på dejt med Justins bäste vän.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror att hon har tämjt Justin, men han har kanske inte kommit över Audrina än. När Holly ballar ur på ett event så tvingas Heidi ta upp hennes alkoholproblem med sin syster.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spelar svårfångad med Kristin, men hans plan går i stöpet. Hollys supande gör att Heidi och Stephanie ordnar en intervention. Brody och Jayde börjar slåss och tvingas tänka över sin vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin hamnar på hal is efter det att Kristin och Audrina till slut träffats. Det enda Heidi vill ha i födelsedagspresent är en bebis, men Spencer har siktet inställt på nåt helt annat.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody funderar på att börja dejta igen, men när de träffar Jayde inser de att tidpunkten är fel. Audrina och Justin diskuterar sin framtid, men det slutar inte som hon hoppats. Spencer tar till drastiska metoder mot Heidis bebisdrömmar.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin och Jayde hamnar i bråk när hon försöker att få tillbaka Brody. Heidi planerar att bli gravid vare sig Spencer vill det eller inte, och Audrina bearbetar det faktum att Justin fortfarande har känslor för Kristin.
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vill inte bli ihop med Justin, men han ger sig inte utan kamp och Audrina gör slut med Justin för gott. Brody får kalla fötter när Jayde vill flytta in hos honom och Spencer har ångest över att Heidi kan vara gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin och Justin tar förhållandet till nästa nivå och Spencer konfronterar Heidi om gravtestet. Brody kanske fortfarande hyser känslor för Kristin efter det att Jayde talat ut om deras förhållande på en förlovningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Det blir inte roligt för Heidi att komma hem när mamma ogillar att hon gjort plastikkirurgi. Kristin och tjejerna åker till Miami för Super Bowl-helgen, men resan går snett när hennes festande börjar oroa Audrina, Lo och Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: När det börjar gå rykten om Kristins festande får Stephanie skulden. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille, men det hindrar inte Brody från att jaga henne. Spencer blir upprörd när han springer på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi har fest för sin granne, men festen hamnar i skymundan när Spencer blir arg på Holly. Kristin tycker att Audrina ska vara med Ryan och försöker sen komma närmare Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidis och Spencers beteende tvingar deras vänner och familjer att göra ett svårt val. Kristin och Brody får ihop det, men båda vill hellre vara singel. Ryan gör Audrina besviken när han aldrig dyker upp trots att de ska gå ut.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin har svårt att gå vidare från Brody. Audrina råkar på Justin och börjar tveka över sitt förhållande med Ryan. Lo slår upp en bekantskap med Brodys nya flickvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nya kärlek gör Kristin till sin fiende när hon tar med en gammal rival till Kristins fest. Ryan kommer hem från turnén, men Audrina berättar inte att hon träffade Justin medan han var bortrest.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas förhållande med Ryan sätts på prov när han träffar Justin för första gången. Brody tar Kristins parti när Aliie börjar bråka med henne. Stephanie går på en andra dejt, men den är en besvikelse.
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: I samma veva som Audrina gör slut med Ryan överraskar Justin henne på födelsedagen. McKaelas vän Allie ställer till mer bråk för Kristin. Brody säger ett sanningens ord till Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: När hela gruppen åker till Costa Rica för att surfa gör blir Brody svartsjuk när Kristin får ihop det med en bartender. Audrina försöker förneka sin attraktion till Justin, och Stephanie passar inte in i djungelmiljön.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody talar ut och hon berättar att hon vill att de försöker på nytt. Heidis mamma besöker LA i hopp om en återförening. Lo och hennes pojkvän firar årsdag, och Stephanie börjar dejta en ny kille.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står inför ett stort beslut som även påverkar Brody. Audrina gör slut med Justin. Lo vet inte om hon är redo för nästa steg med sin pojkvän och Stephanie tror att hon äntligen funnit den rätte.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: En nystart för detta kompisgäng när de återvänder till The Hills och träffar varann för första gången på länge. De ställs inför nya utmaningar, men gamla rivaliteter och romanser ställer till det. Ibland är det förflutna inte förflutet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie försöker att lappa ihop sin relation med brodern Spencer, Mischa säger ifrån till Perez Hilton som mobbade henne när hon var i stjärnljuset. Det slår gnistor mellan Audrina och Justin, men Justin verkar ha fått ögonen på en till.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får veta nåt chockerande om Justin Bobby som får henne att tvivla på hans motiv. Det går hett till när Spencer och Heidi ifrågasätter sin vänskap med Brody. Samtidigt har Brandon Thomas Lee poolfest hos sin mamma.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterar Justin när han förnekar att han kysst henne. Brody funderar över sina relationer till sin far Caitlyn och vän Spencer. Spencer och Heidi försöker få verksamheten att växa vilket sätter deras förhållande på prov.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gänget åker till Vegas för att se Brodys DJ-uppträdande, och Justin hamnar mitt i en uppgörelse mellan Audrina och Stephanie. En skogsbrand härjar i Malibu, och Kaitlynn fruktar för Brodys liv när han stannar i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale!
programme.desc: Ännu ett ex skakar om två av kändisparen. Hemlighålet släpper sin sista bomb, och den sista måltiden medför en stor överraskning! Frågan är, kommer det att sluta lyckligt eller i tårar?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Sex par och deras före detta måste välja: Fria eller gå skilda vägar? Men innan de säger ja, kan de gå vidare från sina ex?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Paren gör sig hemmastadda i villan, men semestern tar slut när de första exen checkar in. Liam blir förkrossad över sanningen om Leylah och hennes ex. Det första Hemlighålet ger ögonöppnande sanningar och överraskande gäster.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Secrets Of The Past
programme.desc: Hemlighyddan välkomnar fler ex, vilket hotar parens stund i paradiset. Sorinn och Lola har ett explosivt bråk under middagen. Ett nytt ex skapar problem för ett par när en hemlig förlovning uppdagas.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Hitting Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Kamie tar med sig paren ut för att de ska våga ta klivet. Sparis och Shaylas till synes perfekta relation får sig en törn. Ett parti sanning eller konsekvens spårar ur när Jamie är respektlös mot Thailah inför hela villan.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: We Need This Time Apart
programme.desc: Kamie ger ett chockerande besked när paren inleder fas två på väg mot förlovning. Sorinns tvivelaktiga sätt att rädda sitt förhållande med Lola kan få det att ta slut. Leylahs kärlekstriangel gör att hon känner sig respektlöst behandlad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Can Love You Better
programme.desc: Alla partner flyttar ut ur villan, och exen får själva reda ut sina problem. I Hemlighyddan får alla partner en tankeställare om sina ex. Samura sätter igång ett explosivt bråk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: More Than Just Your Ex
programme.desc: Exen återupplever sina första dejter, och några börjar tvivla på sina nuvarande förhållanden. Leylah försöker vara Liam trogen medan hon umgås med sitt ex Samura.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Burying Your Relationship
programme.desc: Partnerna återvänder till villan och upptäcker vad de andra har gjort. Leylah fattar ett beslut om sitt förhållande med Liam, medan Spari kommer med ett överraskande förslag.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Call Me By My Name
programme.desc: Ett par gör slut efter ett skandalöst avslöjande. Under en intim stund råkar Thailah kalla sin pojkvän vid exets namn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunited Doesn't Feel So Good
programme.desc: Sparis relation med Shayla prövas när Spari väljer sida i ett villabråk. Ett samtal med Kamie får Thailah att tvivla på sin relation med Jamie.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: This Is What Hearbreak Feels Like
programme.desc: Villan håller andan när ett pars försök att reparera relationen slutar i hjärtesorg. Parens kompatibilitet ifrågasätts på reflektionsceremonin, och vissa par funderar över sin framtid.
programme.sub-title: This Is What Hearbreak Feels Like

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Now Or Never
programme.desc: Paren ska slutligen bestämma om de ska förlova sig eller göra slut. Spari och Shayla pratar ut. Kamie bjuder in några överraskningsgäster för att fira parens slutgiltiga beslut.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Middagsdejt, och så ett ex
programme.desc: Singelkändisarna träffas vid en poolfest & och dyker ner i romantiken. Terrorpaddan berättar om intima middagsdejter, men de får en chock när de får veta att det ska serveras ett ex.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Tagna på sängen
programme.desc: Det är nu eller aldrig för Finn & Paige Kändisarna festar på en strandklubb, där Ashley ifrågasätter sin relation till Jarred, och en överraskningskändis tar Yaz på sängen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Jag drar
programme.desc: Yaz & Chloe Brockett är öppenhjärtiga, medan Finn och Paige brottas med att bo tillsammans i villan. Ett nytt ex skakar om ett par, och det blir för mycket för en kändis.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kärleken är en skakig resa
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch & Finn kommer varandra närmare, vilket är jobbigt för Paige. Det knakar i fogarna mellan Yaz & Chloe Brockett, och ett nytt ex blir ett hot för ett av paren.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Lejonexet
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch hamnar i en kärlekstriangel, vänskapen mellan Yaz & Chloe Brockett rasar samman, båtfesten skakas om av ett ex på vattenskoter, och tre kändisar skickas till stranden när nästa ex lurar i mörkret.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Nattstranden
programme.desc: Lockie & Yaz får en emotionell återförening, men hur ska de kunna bo tillsammans? Chloe lägger alla ägg i samma korg, och ett djävulskt kändisbombnedslag skakar om villan. Vems tid är ute?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Ex är enda vägen
programme.desc: Två ex elimineras och James blir förkrossad, Yaz och Lockie försöker komma förbi sina olikheter, ett nytt kändisex skakar om, och villan tar farväl av en OG.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla och Ryan grälar och hela huset vänder sig emot Kayla när hon avslöjar en känslig sak som kan hota Ambers förhållande med Ethan. En slipprig utmaning visar om vissa par klarar av att hänga ihop.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Hela gänget släpper loss och har kul på vita festen, men John måste ta itu med det faktum att Jacy börjar få känslor för Scali. En strandtävling tvingar paren att sanda ner sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Alla i huset försöker lista ut hur de ska ta tillvara på sina sista chanser att hitta den rätta och vinna en miljon dollar. Jacy tar itu med sina motstridiga känslor för Scali och John och alla i huset försöker nysta ut den sista kärlekstriangeln.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagarna i säsong ett återförenas för den största händelsen i Ethans och Ambers liv - en bebis! Upptäck vad som hänt deltagarna medan de tillbringar en vild helg ihop för att fira med en sanslös babyhippa på AYTO-vis.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: Tio perfekt ihopparade killar och tjejer blir chockade när de får veta att den här säsongen blir tuffare än de trodde med tillkomsten av en elfte tjej. Paris och Pratt smider planer för att slippa sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Läget blir spänt när både Layton och Shelby hamnar i kärlekstrianglar. Killarna gräver upp saker om tjejerna i en tävling som kan skicka den elfte tjejen till sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: När Shelby sätter stopp för sin kärlekstriangel leder det till tårar. John söker kontakt med Christina, men blockeras hela tiden av Brandon, som redan vet att de inte är ett par. Hela huset häpnar över att de har en oskuld i gänget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: Ett hångel på fyllan hotar att stjälpa ett av husets starkaste par. Anthony lägger an på Laytons förälskelse, Jenni. John lägger äntligen in en stöt på Christina. En chockerande parceremoni skakar om hela huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset är i chock efter den senaste parceremonin. Jenni tror att Layton är hennes match, men fruktar vreden från en förkrossad Jessica. Sanningsbåset riskerar att ge ännu mer hjärtesorg för ett av paren.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Tjejerna får överraskande information när deras föräldrar frågar ut killarna. När föräldrarna ger sig av exploderar spänningarna mellan Layton och Anthony. Vi får se att historien kan upprepa sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter ännu en misslyckad parceremoni är huset redo för en nystart. John tror att han äntligen hitta sin match i Jenni, men de andra är inte så säkra. Ashley känner att hon hamnat i vad som kan bli ett explosivt triangeldrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen om Ashley mellan Dario och Layton eskalerar. Ellie får upp ögonen för Nathan, men Nathan är säker på att Christina är den rätta. Trycket från att vara den elfte tjejen blir för mycket för Christina.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Trots att de inte är ett par exploderar Nathan när Christina går tillbaka till Brandon. Med bara två parceremonier kvar kan Ashleys svårighet att välja mellan Layton and Dario göra att ingen vinner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det är dags för den sista parceremonin och ett byte återstår. Medan sanningsbåset levererar några välbehövliga svar, sätter den elfte tjejen priset på en miljon dollar i fara.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hela säsongens hemligheter, drama och oavslutade affärer kommer fram i återföreningsavsnittet när deltagarna turas om att sitta i heta stolen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singlar kommer till Hawaii för att hitta kärleken och vinna en miljon dollar. 'Kärlek vid första ögonkastet' sätts på prov, med 250 000 dollar extra. Ett triangeldrama leder till en pinsam matchningsceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John får ett utbrott när relationen med Julia förändras. Asaf och Francesca ifrågasätts när de misslyckas i boom-boom-rummet. Kaylen släpper en bomb om sin relation med Gio som chockar alla i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: She Don't Want You
programme.desc: Tori och Camille spanar in samma kille. Paren som är på väg till sanningsbåset är under press.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Oron och förvirringen är stor i huset när Gios och Kaylens perfekta relation faller sönder. Asaf delar säng med fel person.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Gio- och Kaylenaffären får alla på helspänn när Gio stöter på Julia och flera andra tjejer i huset. Cam och Victoria har en natt som är lättglömd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Killarna visar sina mjuka sidor när deras mammor avslöjar pinsamma detaljer. Stephen blir extremt paranoid på grund av Gios intresse för Julia. Francesca fångas i Gios klor.

programme.title: What Maisie Knew
programme.desc: Wallace har precis blivit bedragen av sitt livs kärlek när han träffar Chantry. När Chantrys pojkvän Ben tvingas flytta i jobbet kommer Wallace och Chantry närmare varandra och Wallace överväger att berätta för Chantry hur han verkligen känner.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Den hyllade magikern Stanley Crawford bländar sin publik med konststycken av övernaturlig karaktär. Men själv är Stanley en skeptiker när det handlar om det oförklarliga. In i hans liv träder Sophie Baker som är medium, spåkvinna och förförerska.

programme.title: Mustang
programme.desc: Vad fem tonårssystrar ser som en oskyldig lek med några killar tolkas av andra i byn som osedlighet. Historien växer till oanade proportioner och snart börjar systrarnas frihet kringskäras allt mer. Men upproret bubblar under ytan hos systerskaran.

programme.title: Exit Through the Giftshop
programme.desc: Banksys dokumentärfilm om street art som utforskar en fransmans försök att göra en film om Banksy

programme.title: Buena Vista Social Club
programme.desc: Åldrande kubanska musiker vars talanger praktiskt taget har glömts bort efter Castros övertagande av Kuba, tas ut av pensionen av Ry Cooder, som reste till Havanna för att få ihop musikerna.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Florida Project: The Florida Project
programme.desc: Sean Bakers varma dramafilm blev en stor snackis på årets upplaga av Cannes-festivalen. Vi får en inblick i sexåriga Moonees (Brooklynn Prince) tillvaro på budgethotellet The Magic Castle, där hon bor med sin rebelliska mamma Halley (Bria Vinaite).

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: Ett starkt och intimt porträtt av Jackie Kennedy (Natalie Portman) och dagarna som följde efter mordet på hennes make och USAs president John F. Kennedy. Jackie är byggd kring en intervju som presidenthustrun gjorde för tidskriften Life.

programme.title: Carmen & Lola
programme.desc: Sjuttonåriga Carmen är redan förlovad. Hon förväntas snart gifta sig, få många barn och leva som hennes stora romska släkt alltid har gjort i Madrids förorter. Men när Carmen träffar sin fästmans kusin, den sextonåriga Lola, förändras allt.

programme.title: All Quiet on The Western Front
programme.desc: En tysk soldat möter skyttegravskrigens fasor och inser att kriget är en meningslös slakt där hjältedåd bara är en illusion.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a woman disappeared from her Memphis home. When the ransom went uncollected, the FBI suspected a desperate amateur and feared the worst.

programme.title: In the Name of Ben-Hur
programme.desc: A young gladiator enslaved in the Roman arena in 171 A.D. escapes by chariot towards the freedom of Hadrian's Wall. Fighting centurions and mercenaries along the way, he becomes a folk hero for all those struggling to fight Roman oppression.

programme.title: In the Name of Ben-Hur
programme.desc: A young gladiator enslaved in the Roman arena in 171 A.D. escapes by chariot towards the freedom of Hadrian's Wall. Fighting centurions and mercenaries along the way, he becomes a folk hero for all those struggling to fight Roman oppression.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Två av de skeva författarna till Scary Movie siktar nu in sig på den största genren av dem alla: Hollywoods storbudgeterade, specialeffektsladdade, storsäljande franchisefilmer.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: När en klok svart hustler från South Central i Los Angeles befinner sig transporterad tillbaka till medeltida England, leder han störtandet av en ond kung och vinner hjärtat av en protofeministisk kvinna.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy är nyhetsankare i 1970-talets San Diego och tycker att kvinnor har en plats på nyhetsredaktionen. Så när hans nya kollega är en skärpt, ung och vacker kvinna som inte bara är ögongodis blir det krig.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers tillvaro faller samman när två biffiga killar dyker upp: en sexig nu klasskamrat och hennes tråkige med snygge före detta styvbror. Nu får hon lära sig att ifråga om kärlek är hon helt borta.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal
programme.desc: Den vackra Sophia Loren är den österrikiska prinsessan som, trots sin exil från familjegården, föraktar sin mors önskan att gifta sig med en prins.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Pratglade agenten Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) har siktat in sig på New Age-gurun dr Sinja. Men när ett mystiskt Bodhi-träd dyker upp i hans trädgård, inser Jack att det är bäst att han skärper sig innan det sista lövet faller från trädet.

programme.title: Boys And Girls
programme.desc: Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) och Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunde inte vara mer olika. Som barn stod de inte ut med varandra. Som vuxna är det deras olikheter som knyter dem samman i den här roliga romantiska komedin från regissören till SHE'S ALL THAT.

programme.title: Donovan'S Reef
programme.desc: The Duke, Lee Marvin and Jack Warden play navy buddies that made the French Polynesian island of Haleakaloha their post-war paradise. Local headquarters is Donovan's Reef, Wayne's watering hole.

programme.title: Teaaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drömmar om ett stipendium saboteras när hennes lärare, mrs Tingle, anklagar henne för att ha fuskat. I ett desperat försök att bevisa sin oskuld, konspirerar Leigh Ann för att lära mrs Tingle en läxa.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har förtjänat sitt diplom och ett jobb på Callahan Auto Parts. Men familjeföretaget börjar gå dåligt, och nu måste Tommy ge sig ut på resa med sin pappas högra hand, en självbelåten siffertuggare.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.
programme.sub-title: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: Uncover how greed and passion led Jennifer, Tammy and Melissa to betray their men.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode features a woman who murdered her own parents and a woman who helped her husband commit robbery and murder.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: July 2000, Vaucluse, a few kilometers from Avignon. Richard Alessandri, 42, a wealthy supermarket owner, is shot dead in his sleep. Everything suggests that it was a home-jacking gone wrong.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: Jealousy and addiction drove Emilia and Patricia to commit the bloody and violent murders that landed them on death row.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A retired businessman travels from England to Florida to visit his family but dies soon after arriving. Dr. G must now determine what mysteriously killed this healthy man so suddenly.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E01.The 419 Scam & Moving Fraud
programme.desc: No one is immune to this popular form of the age-old advance loan fraud known as the 419 scam.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Thelma Purchase
programme.desc: Care worker Thelma Purchase plotted with her son and a friend to murder disabled Greg Baker who Purchase once worked for. She knew he couldn't defend himself and she stood to be a beneficiary in his will.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Away
programme.desc: Ronald Dalton has an idyllic life – a loving marriage, three beautiful children and a solid career in banking. But in one night, all that is ripped away from him. His wife dies under unusual circumstances and the forensic pathologist says it is murder.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Stranger
programme.desc: Bored at home, a retiree takes a job at a 24-hour convenience store. On her third night at work a customer finds her behind the register in a pool of blood.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A sex and murder-for-hire scandal lands televangelist George Crossley in jail. Paul Winfield narrates.

programme.title: Mind Investigators: Under Pressure
programme.desc: In the fall of 2013, a 23 years old man, volunteer in the army, is arrested for killing his brother.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Story of the murder that ruined Bermuda's reputation as the "safest place in the world." In 1996, 17-year-old Canadian tourist Rebecca Middleton was killed--and her presumed murderer walked free.

programme.title: Exhibit A: The Two Mr. Smiths
programme.desc: Firefighters find two dead bodies on a burning boat in. Another boat has been broken into. The assailants may have drunk beer from the discarded cans on the boat. Whoever broke into the second boat also killed the couple on the burning boat.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Haunted Town of Tombstone
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane explore the wild, haunted history of Tombstone, Arizona in search of gun-slinging ghouls.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Wrong Side of the Road
programme.desc: Police pursuit ends when a stolen vehicle crashes into a house, a violent suspect bites police and police investigate suspicious activity in a van.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stephanie Slater
programme.desc: Estate agent Stephanie Slater reveals the story of her abduction, rape and incarceration, which occurred in 1992 whilst showing a man around a house.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: In December 1986, a young college student was found murdered off a remote highway overpass in San Diego. The thought of a killer roaming the freeways of Southern California's sun-drenched urban paradise had female drivers in the area wrought with fear.

programme.title: South Park: Pre-CIS

programme.title: South Park: Du har 0 vänner
